solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: It's possible a belief's being shaken

indicators.note: letters being shaken up are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's conviction is wobbling, yet a change of mind remains possible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being shaken' rearranges the letters of A BELIEFS; the possessive 's supplies its S here as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something feasible can be done, so it is achievable or possible.

clue.text: Panacea for rising team in trouble

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters are read from bottom to top
the team's letters sit inside the word for trouble

parts.note: to trouble someone is to rile them
XI is eleven in Roman numerals, the size of a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: A struggling side looks for a cure-all to lift its fortunes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns the whole container upwards, since this is a down clue; 'team' as XI is a cricket and football convention.
explanation.definitionFit: An elixir is a supposed remedy for every ill, the same idea as a cure-all.

clue.text: Change dress

explanation.definitionFit: A shift is both a change of position and a loose straight dress.

clue.text: Low joints for workers? That's ideal!

parts.note: worker bees are the classic crossword workers
knees are joints low down on the leg

explanation.surface: An exclamation of approval for something perfect, framed as a joke about insects' legs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for workers' reads as the knees belonging to the bees; 'That's' just introduces the exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: The bee's knees is an informal idiom for something excellent or perfect.

clue.text: Stray sheep seen by us in biblical city

indicators.note: the sheep are straying, so their letters wander into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Lost sheep wander past us on the road to an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stray' looks like an adjective for the sheep, but it is the signal that rearranges them; 'seen by' just sets the two pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Ephesus was an ancient Ionian city to whose church Paul wrote an epistle in the New Testament.

clue.text: People take pains to please him

definitions.text: People take pains to please him

parts.words: People take pains to please him
parts.note: taking pains usually means making an effort, but read literally it means suffering pain, which delights a cruel person

explanation.definitionFit: A sadist takes pleasure in others' suffering, so inflicting pain pleases such a person.

clue.text: There's a scrap when a communist is told to be quiet

parts.note: sh is the sound used to tell someone to hush
red is a common label for a communist

explanation.surface: A fight breaks out when a leftist is ordered to shut up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrap' looks like a fight in the surface, but it means a small torn piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A shred is a tiny fragment or scrap of something.

clue.text: Basic support for sleeping partners?

parts.note: sleeping partners suggests business investors, but here it means a couple who share a bed

explanation.definitionFit: A bed made for two is the furniture that supports a couple at night.

clue.text: To visit a capital is 9 Across

parts.note: to see someone is to visit them
the head is the capital, or top, of the body

explanation.surface: Touring a capital city is presented as a kind of prophecy.
explanation.walkthrough: 9 Across is DIVINE, here in its verb sense of foretelling.
explanation.definitionFit: To foresee what is coming is to predict, the verb sense of the cross-referenced word.

clue.text: Minister is to eat about six

indicators.note: the word for eating goes about, or around, the six

parts.note: to dine is to eat a meal
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A clergyman is due to have dinner at around six o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'approximately six o'clock', but it signals one piece going around the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A divine is an old word for a cleric or theologian, a minister of religion.

clue.text: Labour candidate? He's admitting dirty money taken in return

indicators.note: the first word lets the second in, so it holds it inside

parts.note: the clue word with its apostrophe dropped

indicators.note: the money is turned back to front

parts.note: filthy lucre is money got dishonestly

explanation.surface: A politician standing for the Labour party is accused of accepting bribes.
explanation.walkthrough: Labour is the British left-wing party, but here it means one of the twelve labours of the Greek hero.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek hero was set twelve great tasks, so he was the obvious choice for a labour.

clue.text: I'm sent back with money for betting slips

indicators.note: the two letters are returned, so read backwards

parts.note: the clue word without its apostrophe
stakes are the sums wagered on a bet

explanation.surface: A gambler returns their betting slips with money attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slips' looks like betting slips but is the definition, meaning errors; IM sent back gives MI.
explanation.definitionFit: Slips are small errors, the same as blunders or errors of judgement.

clue.text: Parking in Indian city — or Greek one

indicators.note: the parking letter goes inside the Indian city

parts.note: Delhi is the Indian capital region
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Someone is looking for somewhere to park in an Indian or Greek city.
explanation.definitionFit: Delphi is the ancient Greek site of Apollo's oracle, so it is a Greek city.

clue.text: Transport of delight?

parts.note: a transport of delight is ecstasy, but read literally it is a vessel for enjoyment trips

explanation.definitionFit: A vessel used for leisure trips is literally a means of transport for enjoyment.

clue.text: Wonders when phone exchanges changed name

indicators.note: the letters exchange places with each other, so they are rearranged
the word is changed into a new letter order

explanation.surface: A marvel noted when telephone exchanges were renamed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanges' rearranges PHONE to PHENO and 'changed' rearranges NAME to MENA; 'phone exchanges' looks like telephone hubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Phenomena are remarkable things or events, marvels or wonders.

clue.text: Phone about disruption of trade causing delay

indicators.note: the call goes about, or around, the jumbled letters

parts.note: to ring someone is to phone them

indicators.note: a disruption throws the letters into disorder

explanation.surface: A call about a trade dispute that is holding things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Phone' looks like a noun in the surface but is the verb for making a call.
explanation.definitionFit: Retarding means slowing something down, holding it back.

clue.text: One slum I refurbished — with this?

definitions.text: One slum I refurbished — with this?

indicators.note: a refurbished place is done up anew, so the letters are made over

explanation.surface: Someone does up a run-down dwelling and wonders what paint to use.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the paint you might refurbish a slum with.
explanation.definitionFit: Emulsion is the water-based paint commonly used for redecorating walls.

clue.text: Masqueraded as dressing up predominates

indicators.note: the letters dress up in a disguise, taking a new order

explanation.surface: Fancy dress is the main thing at a party where everyone poses as someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: To pose convincingly as someone else is to have masqueraded as that person.

clue.text: No gear, so refusing to fight?

definitions.meaning: the position of a gearbox when no gear is engaged
taking neither side in a war

explanation.definitionFit: A car out of gear is in this position, and a country staying out of a war is this.

clue.text: Happen to exist before autumn comes

indicators.note: the first piece comes before the second

parts.note: to be is to exist
fall is the American word for autumn

explanation.surface: Something occurs just as the season changes.
explanation.definitionFit: To befall is to happen to someone, often unluckily.

clue.text: Maximum effort at the end of the innings

definitions.text: at the end of the innings
definitions.meaning: in cricket a side is finished when ten batsmen have been dismissed

explanation.walkthrough: An innings is a cricket team's turn to bat; it ends when the side is dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: Going flat out is total effort, and a cricket team whose batting is over has been bowled out completely.

clue.text: Sum for child, a beginner

parts.note: a tot is a small child
L is a learner, from the L-plate on a British learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A simple arithmetic exercise set for a young child just starting out.
explanation.definitionFit: A total is the amount reached by adding numbers up, a sum.

clue.text: Got out of bed?

parts.note: getting out of bed usually means rising in the morning, but here it is a plant pulled from a flower bed

explanation.definitionFit: A plant torn out of the soil, roots and all, has literally left its flower bed.

clue.text: It's obvious minister has been brought up in Old Testament

indicators.note: the minister is placed inside the scripture abbreviation
in a down clue, brought up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a minister's title

explanation.surface: Plainly a clergyman was raised on the Old Testament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reads as upbringing in the surface, but in a down clue it turns the minister's title upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overt is done openly, plain for all to see.

clue.text: One shows the way in business

definitions.text: One shows the way in business

parts.words: One shows the way in business
parts.note: a company board member guides the firm, as a film's leader guides the cast

explanation.definitionFit: A board member who runs a company steers and leads it.

clue.text: He cometh in theatre or cinema production

indicators.note: a production is something made anew, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A character's arrival is staged both on stage and on screen.
explanation.walkthrough: The Iceman Cometh is Eugene O'Neill's play, so the iceman is the one who cometh.
explanation.definitionFit: Eugene O'Neill's play The Iceman Cometh announces this title figure's arrival.

clue.text: Not off to visit, but ready to make one

parts.note: on is the opposite of off
to call on someone is to visit them

explanation.surface: Someone who is not leaving is available to pay a visit when needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' in the definition refers back to the visit, here a call out.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor available for duty out of hours is ready to answer a summons.

clue.text: Not for heavy drinkers?

parts.note: heavy drinkers suggests people who drink a lot, but here heavy is a type of beer

explanation.definitionFit: A weak pale beer is the opposite of a heavy, the Scottish name for a stronger ale.
